description: Returns players whose injury status changed since a time (default the last 24 hours, up to 14 days back), with previous_status, status and detected_at. Statuses are checked against ESPN every 2 minutes from 8am to 1am ET. Use it for "who got hurt or cleared today?" and game-day checks; pass next_since back as since to get only newer changes. Pro plan (Free and Basic keys get 403 pro_required).

since.description: Only changes after this time: ISO-8601 or unix seconds. Default: 24 hours ago; at most 14 days back. Pass a previous answer's next_since to get only newer changes.
since.title: Since

team.description: Only this team. Team code, e.g. BUF or KC. LA/LAR, WSH/WAS and JAC/JAX are interchangeable.
team.title: Team

name: get_injury_changes

changes.description: Per change: player, team, previous_status, status and detected_at.

error.description: Present only when the call failed: what went wrong.

last_checked_at.description: When GridIron last checked injury statuses.

next_since.description: Pass back as since to get only newer changes.

note.description: Present when since was clamped to the 14-day window.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure reason, e.g. basic_required or pro_required.

required_plan.description: The plan that unlocks this data: basic or pro.

status.description: HTTP status of the failed API call.

team_freshness.description: Per team: when its injury report was last checked and updated.

truncated.description: true when more changes exist than limit allowed.

title: Injury status changes
